title: KPAI complaint service SOP: in-person and online complaints, assessment, oversight, monitoring and closing cases (English translation of KPAI's public infographics)
summary: How KPAI receives complaints in person and online, assesses them, oversees how other agencies handle them, monitors progress and closes cases.
summary_id: Cara KPAI menerima pengaduan langsung dan daring, menelaah, mengawasi penanganan oleh instansi lain, memantau, dan menutup kasus.

title: KPAI complaint service SOP: direct and online complaints, assessment, oversight, monitoring and termination, transcribed from KPAI's public infographics (Indonesian original)
summary: Indonesian original of KPAI's complaint SOP: intake, assessment, oversight, monitoring and closing cases.
summary_id: Naskah asli SOP pengaduan KPAI: penerimaan, telaah, pengawasan, pemantauan, dan penutupan kasus.

title: Law 35/2014 amending Law 23/2002 on Child Protection
summary: Child Protection Law: children's rights and the duties of the state, parents and society; bans violence, exploitation and sexual abuse of children with criminal sanctions; special protection; establishes KPAI.
summary_id: UU Perlindungan Anak: hak anak serta kewajiban negara, orang tua, dan masyarakat; larangan kekerasan, eksploitasi, dan kekerasan seksual terhadap anak beserta sanksi pidana; perlindungan khusus; dasar KPAI.

title: Presidential Regulation 61/2016 on the Indonesian Child Protection Commission
summary: KPAI's mandate and organisation: overseeing child protection, receiving complaints, membership and secretariat.
summary_id: Mandat dan organisasi KPAI: pengawasan perlindungan anak, penerimaan pengaduan, keanggotaan, dan sekretariat.

title: Government Regulation 78/2021 on Special Protection for Children
summary: Special protection for children who are victims of violence, exploitation, trafficking or disasters, children with disabilities and children in conflict with the law: prevention, treatment, rehabilitation and assistance, and who provides them.
summary_id: Perlindungan khusus bagi anak korban kekerasan, eksploitasi, perdagangan orang, atau bencana, anak penyandang disabilitas, dan anak berhadapan dengan hukum: pencegahan, penanganan, rehabilitasi, pendampingan, dan pelaksananya.

title: Law 12/2022 on Sexual Violence Crimes (TPKS)
summary: Sexual Violence Crimes Law (TPKS): defines sexual harassment, forced marriage, sexual exploitation, electronic sexual violence and other offences; victims' rights to treatment, protection, recovery and restitution; services through UPTD PPA.
summary_id: UU Tindak Pidana Kekerasan Seksual (TPKS): pelecehan seksual, pemaksaan perkawinan, eksploitasi seksual, kekerasan seksual berbasis elektronik, dan tindak pidana lain; hak korban atas penanganan, pelindungan, pemulihan, dan restitusi; layanan melalui UPTD PPA.

title: Law 11/2012 on the Juvenile Criminal Justice System (SPPA)
summary: Juvenile Criminal Justice Law (SPPA): children aged 12 to 18 in conflict with the law, mandatory diversion for lighter offences, assistance by social workers, and confidentiality of child victims' and witnesses' identity.
summary_id: UU Sistem Peradilan Pidana Anak (SPPA): anak 12–18 tahun yang berhadapan dengan hukum, diversi wajib untuk tindak pidana ringan, pendampingan pekerja sosial, dan kerahasiaan identitas anak korban dan saksi.

title: Law 21/2007 on the Eradication of Human Trafficking (TPPO)
summary: Human Trafficking Law (TPPO): trafficking offences and penalties, heavier when the victim is a child; restitution, rehabilitation and return of victims.
summary_id: UU Pemberantasan Tindak Pidana Perdagangan Orang (TPPO): tindak pidana dan sanksinya, lebih berat bila korban anak; restitusi, rehabilitasi, dan pemulangan korban.

title: Law 44/2008 on Pornography
summary: Pornography Law: bans making and spreading pornography, including any involving children, and protects children from exposure; criminal sanctions.
summary_id: UU Pornografi: larangan membuat dan menyebarkan pornografi, termasuk yang melibatkan anak, serta perlindungan anak dari paparan; sanksi pidana.

title: Law 23/2004 on the Elimination of Domestic Violence (PKDRT)
summary: Domestic Violence Law (PKDRT): physical, psychological and sexual violence and neglect in the household; victims' rights, protection orders, police duties and criminal penalties.
summary_id: UU Penghapusan Kekerasan dalam Rumah Tangga (PKDRT): kekerasan fisik, psikis, seksual, dan penelantaran dalam rumah tangga; hak korban, perintah perlindungan, kewajiban polisi, dan sanksi pidana.

title: Law 16/2019 amending the Marriage Law (minimum marriage age 19)
summary: Raises the minimum marriage age to 19 for women and men; a court may grant dispensation only for urgent reasons with supporting evidence.
summary_id: Menaikkan batas usia perkawinan menjadi 19 tahun bagi perempuan dan laki-laki; dispensasi pengadilan hanya untuk alasan mendesak dengan bukti pendukung.

title: PANRB Ministerial Regulation 5/2025 on public service complaint management
issuer: Ministry of Administrative and Bureaucratic Reform
summary: Public service complaint management: complaint channels including SP4N-LAPOR!, handling deadlines, follow-up and reporting duties of agencies.
summary_id: Pengelolaan pengaduan pelayanan publik: kanal pengaduan termasuk SP4N-LAPOR!, batas waktu penanganan, tindak lanjut, dan kewajiban pelaporan instansi.
